frontend.output_history: external sink; estimator retains last valid publication only

optimizer.initialization: previous accepted active estimates plus Odom prediction

provenance.clock: common VM bag receipt domain, not synchronized sensor-header domain
provenance.initial: this independent segment first5s four-wall data, no manual coordinates
provenance.geometry: historical unchanged anchors/heights; no accepted extrinsic uncertainty model
provenance.weights: inherited engineering assumptions, not calibrated probability model

replay.eof_policy: no timer advance beyond last recorded receipt

adapter.field_model: conditional; unverified geometric-center to odom-origin equivalence
adapter.heading: nominal room +X at start; 5deg inherited prior, not calibrated heading uncertainty
adapter.initialization: first 5s after recorded start stable begins; four-wall nonlinear least squares only; no manual XY used by estimator
adapter.clock: VM bag receipt association; preserve original header and prefix availability; no physical clock calibration claim
adapter.odom: latest arrived receipt at/before state time; max age 0.5s; skip frame if either missing; retain actual cumulative XY and quaternion yaw
adapter.gyro: published Z engineering axis; left hold max100ms; no complete angular factor on any gap; no odom angular fallback
adapter.weights: unchanged inherited engineering weights and zero range corrections, not calibrated probabilities
adapter.peer: car1 node_0 only; reverse direction not duplicated as independent factor
adapter.evaluation: all four manually measured stable windows; valid and failure coverage separate; no reference interpolation through motion
adapter.main_scope: conditional reserved stop-point confirmation; no continuous position truth
adapter.heldout: decode only after FINAL_LOCK; references enter evaluation only
adapter.limits: no parameter search, no new field collection, no old batch rerun; max1200s per cell CPU1
adapter.segment_reset: fresh graph, prior, angular buffer and history per unit; no bridge across B2 gap
adapter.failure: preserve all scheduled frames; missing odom invalidates frame; invalid gyro supplies no angular factor; preparation exceptions unavailable; run exceptions abort and pad remaining frames invalid; no silent retries or tuning
